method_notes.role: Fourth-family adjudication of three independent gold label sets. No relabelling from scratch, no scoring, no Skill execution, and no access to question design or oracle notes.
method_notes.ratings_and_required_lists: Majority of grok, gemini and gpt, except where a v3.3 rating rule or GOLD_RUBRIC forces a different resolution. Required concept lists were tallied per item after synonym normalisation and kept when at least two families listed the concept.
method_notes.allowed_lists: Union of the three families after synonym normalisation, minus concepts that contradict the adjudicated rating or are unsupported by the case facts. Every exclusion is recorded per turn with its reason.
method_notes.critical_invariants: A token is kept when at least two families listed it. Every turn matched that rule without adjustment.
method_notes.uncertainty: gold_uncertain is set only where the three families disagree categorically and the case text plus the v3.3 rules cannot resolve the turn. All five split turns were resolvable, so uncertain_turns is 0 of 24 against a cap of 4.
v33_rules_applied: Established omission: where Data A makes a named execution step depend on token X and the identifiable Data B body omits X, responsibility is Red rather than Gray (V333-004, V333-005, V333-006, V333-007, V333-008, V333-015 turn 1).
Gray is retained where Data B carries an unconfirmed token that Data A locates off-record and does not quote (V333-009).
An unreadable Data A / background token with an identifiable sendable draft stays in Normal mode with the affected dimension Gray and a question, rather than becoming Intake (V333-009).
No case in this attempt has an illegible material Data B token, so no turn routes to Intake; both PNG drafts are fully legible and their sha256 values match the case declarations.
preserve-intended-recipient never appears in required_revision_concepts and is allowed only.
Green/Green turns take required_revision_concepts ['no-revision'] and no rewrite.
Overall status is derived as Red > Gray > Yellow > Green on every rated turn; Scope turns carry null ratings.
Scope applies where the recipient is explicitly not a manager and no manager is included (V333-017).
method_notes.synonym_policy: Where two families named the same specific missing question or revision fact under different ids, the ids were normalised to one canonical id so the per-item tally reflects agreement rather than wording. A generic ontology concept and a narrower suite-local fact were not merged; both were kept, the narrower one in the allowed list unless it reached two votes.
method_notes.suite_local_concepts: Suite-local concept ids are used where no ontology concept names the actual missing token or revision fact. Every id used in any required or allowed list is defined in gold-v333-raw.json definitions.question or definitions.revision.
